name: difficulty more seeds
description: N12.2: the confirm plan (difficulty.json) again on seeds 2001-2200, so the confirm reads 800 matches a difficulty: are Hard's and Easy's no-edge rates really under Normal's (seeds 1001-1200 had them 6 points under), and does the edge move each by about 8? N12.2: the player's win rate against an even-rated rival on each difficulty, in the match itself. Each seed a new game's squad on that difficulty through its opening lineup against a rival's generated squad level with its best nine (through the rival coach's auto-pick), the rival with the difficulty's edge after the spread (difficulty.<d>.rivalEdge), both ways round: 400 matches a difficulty, on seeds the sweep (difficulty-sweep.json, seeds 1-150) did not play. 'no edge' is the match before N12.2 (Normal is the same in both rows). The player's win rate is the home win share of 'player v rival' and 1 - home win - drawn of 'rival v player'; homeMargin and nine are in results.jsonl.
